panels.title: Network topology — OBA → Proxy → Displays
panels.description: Static pipeline topology with live node/edge labels pulled from the latest InfluxDB points. Replaces the retired /monitor SVG topology.

targets.query:
import "array"
apiCalls = from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_counter" and r.name == "api_calls_total" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
clients = from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_gauge" and r.name == "active_clients" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
throttle = from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_gauge" and r.name == "throttle_rate" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
refresh = from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_gauge" and r.name == "refresh_interval" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
apiCallsV = if length(arr: apiCalls) > 0 then apiCalls[0] else 0.0
clientsV = if length(arr: clients) > 0 then clients[0] else 0.0
throttleV = if length(arr: throttle) > 0 then throttle[0] else 0.0
refreshV = if length(arr: refresh) > 0 then refresh[0] else 30.0
array.from(rows: [
  {id: "oba", title: "OneBusAway API", subTitle: "upstream provider", mainStat: "calls: " + string(v: int(v: apiCallsV)), secondaryStat: "throttle: " + string(v: throttleV) + "%"},
  {id: "proxy", title: "Transit Proxy", subTitle: ":8000", mainStat: "clients: " + string(v: int(v: clientsV)), secondaryStat: "refresh: " + string(v: int(v: refreshV)) + "s"},
  {id: "displays", title: "Displays", subTitle: "ESP32 / simulator", mainStat: "active: " + string(v: int(v: clientsV)), secondaryStat: ""},
])

import "array"
refresh = from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_gauge" and r.name == "refresh_interval" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
refreshV = if length(arr: refresh) > 0 then refresh[0] else 30.0
array.from(rows: [
  {id: "e1", source: "oba", target: "proxy", mainStat: "poll / " + string(v: int(v: refreshV)) + "s"},
  {id: "e2", source: "proxy", target: "displays", mainStat: "schedule push"},
])

from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_gauge" and r.name == "active_clients" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_counter" and r.name == "api_calls_total" and r._field == "value")
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()

from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_gauge" and r.name == "throttle_rate" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_counter" and r.name == "api_errors_total" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_gauge" and r.name == "api_latency_ms" and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trip_prediction" and r._field == "arrival_time_s")
  |> group(columns: ["route_id", "route_name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_counter" and r.name == "ws_connections_total" and r._field == "value")
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "connects/min")

from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_counter" and r.name == "ws_disconnections_total" and r._field == "value")
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "disconnects/min")

from(bucket: "transit_tracker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trip_prediction")
  |> pivot(
       rowKey: ["_time", "route_id", "route_name", "stop_id", "headsign", "is_realtime"],
       columnKey: ["_field"],
       valueColumn: "_value"
     )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with arrival_time_ms: int(v: r.arrival_time_s) * 1000 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "route_name", "stop_id", "headsign", "is_realtime", "arrival_time_ms"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 100)
